To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the most efficient sampling methods for bioaerosols of the bacterium Chlamydophyla psittaci are the MAS-100 impaction method using ChlamyTrap1 impaction medium and the IOM inhalation dust sampler with gelatin filter.

(1) gelatin filters in combination with the inhalable dust sampler are suitable for personal bioaerosols sampling, (2) the MAS-100 in combination with the ChlamyTrap medium is the best method for stationary bioaerosols monitoring and (3) the AGI-300 in combination with the BioSampler is not suitable for either personal or stationary bioaerosoll monitoring.

the combination of a gelatin membrane filter in combination with an IOM inhalable aerosol sampler and a newly designed ChlamyTrap medium in combination with the newly developed MAS-100 impact sampler were the most sensitive techniques for the detection and quantification of C. psitacci bioaerosols.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and optimization of bioaerosolsampling techniques for the detection and quantification of C. psittacl.
the development of a highly sensitive method to detect C. psittacii in contaminated air.
the development of highly sensitive and specific methods for the detection of C. psititaci bioaerosols in order to prevent the spread of this disease in the environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MAS-100 with the newly developed ChlamyTrap media is the best sampling technique for stationary bioaerosols, and the IOM sampler with gelatin filter is recommended for personal sampling.
the use of a filter impaction sampler (IOM) with gelatin filters and the MAS-100 sampler with ChlamyTrap medium would be the best choice for bioaerosols containing C. psittici.

the MAS-100 impaction sampler in combination with the ChlamyTrap media is the most sensitive and efficient bioaerosol sampler for detection of C. psitaci in air, followed by the gelatin filter in the IOM inhalation sampler and the BioSampler impingement sampler in combination with ChlamyTrap medium.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of the IOM inhalation sampler in conjunction with a gelatin filter and the MAS-100 sampler in combination with ChlamyTrap impaction media are the most suitable techniques for the detection, enumeration, and monitoring of C. psititaci in air.
we developed a new sampling device, ChlamyTrap, which allows for the detection of C. psitacci in air.
the use of the MAS-100 in combination with ChlamyTrap media and a PCR assay is a highly sensitive method for the detection of bioaerosols.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the detection of C. psititaci in air samples is feasible with the right sampling and detection methods.
it is possible to develop sensitive bioaerosol samplers for the detection of C. psittacli and other microorganisms of interest.
the use of a suitable sampling medium is critical for bioaerosols sampling.
